title: Raster Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🖨️raster plugin from its old 8-crate constitutional layout to the new single-crate taxonomy layout, following the proven recipe in CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/TEMPLATE.md. Old crates: manifest/artifact, apps/raster (root), apps/raster/modules/{engine,dsl,op,pack,protocol,ui}. New crate: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🖨️raster/📦️packages/🦀️rust (semio-s-plugin-raster). Capture test baseline + wire-format baseline before touching anything, move code per the taxonomy mapping table, decompose commands with app_commands!, verify (check/clippy/test/wasm), delete old crates only once green, and end with a registrar handoff block (do not touch root Cargo.toml myself).
